column1:
Strong civil society participation 
(with both women and men at the 
frontline) in transport development 
and management
column2:
• 	What	policies	and	mechanisms	are	
in place to facilitate the participation 
of the communities and community-
based organizations (including 
women) in transport sector 
development and management 
(including road safety)?
• 	Who	implements	these	mechanisms?	
What is the participation of 
nongovernment organizations 
(NGOs)?
• 	What	are	the	beliefs	and	practices	
of the communities with regard to 
women’s participation in community 
initiatives related to transport 
development and management?
• 	What	capacity	development	
(orientation, values transformation, 
skills, etc.) do men and women need 
to enable women’s participation in 
these community initiatives?
column3:
• 	Formulate	policies,	programs,	
and mechanisms for gender-
responsive community participation 
in transport development and 
management (including road safety).
• 	Engage	NGOs	in	mobilizing	
community (including women’s) 
participation.
• 	Promote	gender	awareness	and	
sensitivity in the communities.
• 	Train	women	to	participate	in	
community initiatives for transport 
development and management.
• 	Develop	videos	and	case	studies	
on model community participation 
in transport development and 
management.
